summary: Mirroring images for an air-gapped self-service automation portal install: podman login to registry.redhat.io and the disconnected registry, pull, tag and push rhdh/rhdh-hub-rhel9, optionally the PostgreSQL 15 image (built-in database only) and the automation-portal OCI plug-in image.
questions: How do I mirror images for self-service automation portal offline?
Which images does the self-service portal need in a disconnected cluster?
Do I need to mirror PostgreSQL for the self-service portal?
